thread_analysis.thread_summary: Single-message internal consulting thread (Itsuo Sakai, Kentaro Taniguchi) reviewing and refining draft reply wording for a new inquiry from Yaman, regarding whether Bluetooth product registration is required when a product doesn't display the Bluetooth logo. The thread is purely about wordsmithing the official answer before it's sent.
all_questions_found: Is Bluetooth registration required even when the product doesn't display the Bluetooth logo? (see thread_0034_case_01)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The thread's single technical point (case_01) establishes that registration obligation is tied to bringing a Bluetooth product to market under one's own brand, independent of logo display, and that this should be substantiated by citing Bluetooth SIG's own 'Do I Need to Qualify?' documentation rather than asserted without a source.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: See thread_0034_case_01 -- a customer skipping registration under the mistaken belief that avoiding the logo exempts them could later face compliance enforcement.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None identified -- this thread is purely an internal pre-send wording review.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: When explaining a compliance obligation to a customer, cite the authoritative source (Bluetooth SIG's own documentation) directly rather than asserting the rule unsupported.
